name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 129

clue.text: Exactly where does the rent go?
Little fairy endlessly flitted around
Concern about technique needed for ornamental drawing
More pleasant French resort by river
Right across road you’ ll find petrol
Holds up kangaroo mother — finally managed to find pouch
Crop I planted in the middle of lots of paths
Standard group of workers employed by plant
Contemporary code broken by strange misbehaviour
Inside part of French bathroom fitting
Soup I left, making mouth sore
Gods largely ill-disposed
Inclined to join a fight
Showing extreme desire to join Labour association
Island of vital importance
Keep quiet in case operation is very fast with only brief pauses
Twitch at regular intervals?
Constellation reportedly in the shape of a doughnut
Being responsible for love I have found wearing
Former wife gets most of premier residence and personal funds
Bill dropped by player, a lock
Weakened by ill-health, fell
Bound to catch corrupt cleric with no way out
“‘Waged war like Galahad” reported magazine
One must pull strings to operate this firework
Secure against loss if my dinner not completely cooked
Johnny-come-lately, one given one award after another
Take heed, around zero Celsius, climbing and turning on ice
Wear something to cover face up with insect around
Some national assistance used for drink
Be discriminatory — cut off first son
Doctor taking a break
